caption_L1: Here a bar diagram is titled Number of provider contracts of top healthcare management consulting firms in the United States in 2013. The x-axis measures Number of provider contracts while the y-axis shows top healthcare management consulting firms.
caption_L2L3: Out of the top 10 healthcare management consulting firms, Advisory Board Co. (Washington) had the highest number of provider contracts at over 3300.  This is more than double the number of any other of the top firms and significantly higher than the next firm, which was Croe Horwath (Chicago) with just over 1200.  Just behind Croe Horwath was KPMG (New York) with approximately 1100 contracts.  Perficient (St. Louis) had the least number of contracts at around 200.
